name: hub
lead: The Minefort hub: servers, experiences and portals.

functions.name: servers
functions.signature: hub.servers() → { {id: string, name: string, category: string, motd: string ?, icon: string ?, banner: string ?, players: number ?, maxPlayers: number ?} }
functions.description: The players' servers that are online, and the published experiences (`category == "experience"`). `id` is what `player:connect` takes.

functions.name: experiences
functions.signature: hub.experiences() → { {slot: number, experience: string, title: string, pitch: string ?, icon: string ?, banner: string ?, players: number ?} }
functions.description: The portals of the experience grounds. `experience` is what `/play` takes.

functions.name: hubs
functions.signature: hub.hubs() → { {id: string, name: string, players: number ?, region: string ?} }
functions.description: Every hub that is online, this one included. `id` is what `player:connect` takes.

functions.name: rent
functions.signature: hub.rent(player: Player | string, slot: number, product: string, experience: string ?) → string ?
functions.description: Offers portal `slot` for Gems, to lead to `experience` (what `/play` takes). Returns the request id, or nil. More time on your own portal may leave `experience` out.

functions.name: point
functions.signature: hub.point(player: Player | string, slot: number, experience: string) → boolean
functions.description: Turns the player's own live portal to another published experience.

title: hub global
